avis.texte: I bought this for my 17-year-old granddaughter. She likes it a lot and I have provided a refill for her.

avis.titre: Probably made for people with normal skin
avis.texte: If you have very dry skin skin I suggest you dont get this product. I usually give products a week before i decide what i think of it but this product only lasted me 2 days and I immediately returned it. It kinda just felt like i was rubbing cream on my face and it wasnt doing anything no hydration at all. I dont think it did much for much for my skin honestly. But maybe if you have "normal" skin then it be good for that. But for me i need deep hydration. ( ALSO THE SMELL IS BAD 😭😭✌️✌️)
Keeps my sensitive skin hydrated without feeling greasy and without any irritation. A little goes a long way. Highly recommend!

I've been a loyal Dermalogica user for over 20 years and I have genuinely loved each product. However, I just purchased this because my face has become extra dry this super cold winter and I was looking for something a bit more moisturizing than the Powerbright I normally use. One thing I really like about Dermalogica products is their light, natural fragrances. Whether it be lavender, citrus, or something else. Unfortunately even though this moisturizes really well, it smells horrible. Like when you blow up a latex balloon and the smell abd taste gets on your fingers and lips. I tried it last night for the first time and was immediately grossed out. I just tried it again tonight and it just smells bad. I'm glad I only purchased the smallest size just in case I didn't like it for some reason. If you're looking for an excellent moisturizer, this is it. If you are a person who loves high end fragranced skincare that smells amazing, this is not it.
Love all Dermatologic products. This one makes my skin feel so soft and smooth.
This is the best, my dry skin loves it. Very good for sensitive skin with damaged barrier.

Very disappointed in this product that claims to be so moisture rich and especially for the high price tag. It has done nothing for my skin. In fact, I have to apply another brand of moisturizer over it to provide hydration before I can even attempt to apply my makeup. Store brand works better for far less money.
I have oily, sensitive skin & unfortunately this did not work for me. Its not greasy, per se, but not lightweight enough for me, which caused me to break out.

This burns my face ! but it does go away. It doesn't smell good either but other than that it's a fine product. I'm not sure if this or something else made my face peel a little but I'm gonna think it's this given. It's the only thing that's been burning on my face and it contains lactic acid, which is an exfoliate.

avis.titre: Wish I had bought the bigger size

Skin smoothing cream moisturizer is one of the best I've used. It's very light-weight, absorbs fast and moisturizes well. I use it every morning and evening after clenser, toner and a serum. I like that it's neither sticky nor oily, and it works well under sunscreen. I like that it's rather thin, as I find the other, richer ones, harder to apply. I have a sensitive combination skin that has become dry with age, and I haven't had any issues with this product. I have repurchased it twice.

Esti in school here! I love this product! I use it at home and it is apart of my every day skin routine at this point. It really does help smooth out the top layer of the skin for a more even look over time. I have seen boosts in hydration on my face for sure! Definitely recommend trying this product if you're dry and looking for a hydrating moisturizer that's not too thick that can be worn in the daytime.
Loved it! It kept my skin hydrated and was. Strong part of my morning routine.

Within a couple of days I had horrible deep breakouts under my skin and something that looked like a rash down my neck. I know everyones skin reacts differently but this was not for me. Returned and went back to my drunk elephant.

I was having terrible dryness on my skin, specially in my forehead, starting a rutine with dermalogica products has been life changing, I suggest combining with a toner to lock the moisture of this cream.

I've only been using this product for about a week and bought thr travel size to try it out, but I can tell already my skin has never felt and looked better! For about over a year I have been struggling with my face (ezcema, acene, other dry spots, discoloration) and Cerave products were my holy grail, until it wasn't, since then I have tried numerous products, spent $$$$ and nothing work. For the last 3-4months I have been using La Roche Posay face wash & face moisturizer and its been blah. I have only been using it bc i refused to try something else and spend more money. Finally, my sister suggested Dermalogica and OMG!! All this time I had been suffering. I bought the travel size to test it out bc the full size are pricey, but let me tell you, I don't care they are expensive anymore. I have already purchased the full size products and have a full regimen for my facs. Like I said, I've only been using the face mositurizer, face wash, the blue bottle exfoliter (twice a week), and the brightening kit (only at night) (all travel size) and my face looks & feels amazing. These are expensive products, but theres a spanish saying "lo bueno cuesta", in english "the good things cost" and with these products, I can agree. Also, a little bit really goes a long way. For the face wash, I only use a pea size and its really more than enough and prettu much same off all other products.
